_comment: Governance planning metadata: RowVersion byte[] exists on Order, InventoryItem, Shift (see Domain + migration). Payment / InventoryMovement remain planning-only entries until an explicit phase.

entities.name: InventoryItem
entities.notes: CurrentStock updates from finalize and sync paths; RowVersion on InventoryItem enables optimistic concurrency — stale writers get DbUpdateConcurrencyException; sync push paths remain separate risk surface.

entities.name: InventoryMovement
entities.notes: Append-heavy ledger rows; duplicate sync replays can still insert duplicate movements without durable per-operation idempotency — token helps detect conflicting writes, not replay dedupe alone.

entities.name: Order
entities.notes: Aggregate root now carries RowVersion; concurrent finalize/void paths surface conflicts via Application handlers + HTTP 409 — Payment rows remain non-tokenized child entities.

entities.name: Payment
entities.notes: Rows created inside finalize transaction; Paid idempotency avoids duplicate rows for same finalize key, but broader concurrent mutation windows remain unversioned at the row level.

entities.name: Shift
entities.notes: Shift rows include RowVersion; concurrent shift mutations can conflict — broader sync/outbox semantics unchanged.
